area: Encrypted stores on by default (store_crypto.py) with the one-time migration of plain stores, and the managed-name prefix for policy packs (name_prefix.py)
title: Wave 10: secure-by-default store encryption with a verified, resumable migration, and an operator-chosen managed-name prefix

coverage.how: every acceptance item of the spec mapped to a test: tests/test_store_encryption_default.py (default on, migration, interrupted and rerun, opt-out, key fallback, no plaintext left, rotation, FIPS) and tests/test_name_prefix.py (validation, preview, deploy, reuse, removal, Terraform)

checks.what: A fresh install with no setting seals every store; only 0/off/false/no opt out
Plain stores from an earlier version are sealed once at start-up after a verified backup; an interrupted run resumes; a file that does not read back is restored from the backup
No plain copy is left behind: backup, per-file journal and stale temporary files are removed when every file reads back
The key goes to the credential store where one answers, else to the owner-only key file; a ring that cannot be read is never replaced by a new key
Rotation re-seals every store and forgets the old key after the migration; FIPS mode unchanged
A managed-name prefix is validated (no brackets, control or bidi characters, the tool's own name, over 16 characters) and an invalid one blocks the plan before the tenant is read

The prefix is shown in the preview and bound in the plan hash; every pack name is prefixed; an object found only under the prefixed name is reused but never counted as this app's, and a removal keeps it unless its tag or a deployment record for the tenant lists it

findings.title: A credential store that could not be read (locked) let a new store key be made and saved over the existing entry, orphaning every sealed store
findings.fix: Keys are read from the credential store and the key file together; a new key is made only when nothing that might hold one failed to read, and used only after it reads back

findings.title: With encryption on, a key saved to the credential store but not readable from it could be used to seal stores
findings.fix: The ring is read back after every save (credential store, else key file) before the key is used

findings.title: The store key, the migration journal and its plaintext backup were neither git- nor docker-ignored, so a native install's key could be committed or baked into an image
A pack name that already started with the prefix was not prefixed, so the customer's own object under that name was reused as this app's
A removal deleted an untagged object found only under the managed-name prefix
findings.fix: A prefix match is kept unless the tag or a deployment record for this tenant lists its id; the preview says so

findings.title: A prefix holding AND, OR or NOT put expression keywords into every dictionary reference (D:name)
findings.fix: Refused as whole words, any case

findings.title: Plain copies could stay behind: temporary files under the stores' real names, damaged copies, a backup folder whose removal failed, and the full backup of a stopped migration
findings.fix: Real temp names removed at every start; damaged copies sealed; removal checked; a stopped migration keeps only unsealed backups and says so in status and on the Team page

findings.title: A rotation forgot the old key even when a file (a damaged copy, a racing write) still named it
findings.fix: Every store file is read again before the old key is dropped; a key still named is kept

findings.title: status() reported where a key would go, and a named key file was deleted when a credential store appeared
findings.fix: Status reads where the ring is; a DLP_CHECK_STORE_KEY_FILE is always used and never deleted

findings.title: With encryption on, a sealed snapshot over its size limit was cut short and reported as damaged
findings.fix: Over the cap is 'too large' before the file is opened

findings.title: The suite ran with encryption off, so secret-canary checks of store files passed on ciphertext
findings.fix: The suite runs with the shipped default; tests open stores through store_crypto helpers
